CoACD 1.0.11 editor integration

Source: https://github.com/SarahWeiii/CoACD
Release: https://github.com/SarahWeiii/CoACD/releases/tag/1.0.11
License: MIT

HIKARI loads bin/win-x64/lib_coacd.dll dynamically. The dependency is used
only by model-collision authoring. Runtime collision assets and packaged games
do not depend on CoACD.
